nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid overcommitting to early aggression that could delay tech or economy.
nodes.decision_direction: Maintain current development path, focusing on economy and technology while keeping a light defensive presence.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when the opponent's composition or pressure becomes clearer, or when transitioning to the next phase.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move to a state with heavier production and the addition of Siege Tanks.
nodes.opponent_situation: Zerg opponent is likely to be expanding and may apply early pressure. Exact composition is uncertain.
nodes.own_situation: Early game with a ground-oriented army, moderate production, and heavy technology investment. Economy and expansion are heavy, but defense is light. Representative units include Marines and Reapers.
nodes.strategic_reason: A heavy economy and tech investment sets up for a strong midgame, while light defense is sufficient if scouting indicates no immediate threat.
nodes.title: Early Game Foundation
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a heavier production and more robust army composition as the game progresses.
nodes.trigger_summary: At the start of the game, focus on establishing a solid economy and early tech while keeping a light defensive posture.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid neglecting scouting or over-investing in tech without army support.
nodes.decision_direction: Maintain the current path, continuing to build up production and tech while keeping an eye on defense.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when the opponent's tech or army composition becomes more apparent.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move to a state with moderate air presence and Medivacs added.
nodes.opponent_situation: Zerg may be transitioning to a more tech-heavy composition or preparing a timing attack. Exact composition is uncertain.
nodes.own_situation: Early-midgame with a ground-oriented army, heavy production, and heavy technology. Economy and expansion remain heavy. Representative units include Siege Tanks, Marines, and Reapers.
nodes.strategic_reason: Siege Tanks provide strong defensive and positional strength, supporting a macro-oriented approach.
nodes.title: Early-Mid Transition
nodes.transition_goal: Continue expanding and teching while preparing for potential midgame engagements.
nodes.trigger_summary: As the game enters the early-mid phase, production becomes heavier and Siege Tanks are added to the army.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being caught off guard by tech switches; keep scouting.
nodes.decision_direction: Maintain the current path, focusing on army composition and upgrades while keeping defensive structures.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when the opponent's tech path is clear or when transitioning to late game.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move to a state with heavier defense and Marauders.
nodes.opponent_situation: Zerg may have a mix of ground and air units, possibly including Mutalisks or Banelings. Exact composition is uncertain.
nodes.own_situation: Midgame with a ground-oriented army, heavy production, and heavy technology. Economy and expansion are heavy. Representative units include Siege Tanks, Marines, Reapers, and Medivacs.
nodes.strategic_reason: Medivacs add sustain and mobility, allowing for better map control and multi-pronged pressure.
nodes.title: Midgame Consolidation
nodes.transition_goal: Prepare for late-midgame by adding Marauders and increasing air presence.
nodes.trigger_summary: In the midgame, the army becomes more rounded with Medivacs for mobility and healing, while production and tech remain heavy.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid overextending without proper scouting or army composition adjustments.
nodes.decision_direction: Maintain the current path, continuing to build a strong ground army while adding air support.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when the opponent's final composition is known or when reaching max supply.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue developing towards a late-game army with heavy air presence.
nodes.opponent_situation: Zerg may have a large army with a mix of ground and air, possibly including Brood Lords or Ultralisks. Exact composition is uncertain.
nodes.own_situation: Late-midgame with a ground-oriented army, heavy production, and heavy technology. Economy and expansion are heavy, and defense is heavy. Representative units include Siege Tanks, Marines, Reapers, and Marauders.
nodes.strategic_reason: Marauders provide anti-armor capability, and heavier defense helps withstand Zerg's late-game pushes.
nodes.title: Late-Midgame Strength
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-game composition with more air units and possibly Ghosts or Vikings.
nodes.trigger_summary: In the late-midgame, the army includes Marauders for anti-armor, and defense becomes heavier. Air presence is increasing.

opening.flexibility_note: This is a strategic template, not a fixed build order.
opening.opening_summary: A Terran opening that develops a heavy economy and technology while maintaining a ground-oriented army. It transitions from light early pressure to a robust midgame composition with Siege Tanks, Marines, and Medivacs, and eventually adds Marauders and heavier air presence.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a balanced macro posture while preserving flexibility for live observation-driven adaptation.
